question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

Someone who avoids other people's company.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Reclusive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The group of words **"Someone who avoids other people's company**" can be substituted with the word **"Reclusive".**
 
• **"Reclusive"** refers to a person who lives in voluntary seclusion from the public and society.(वैरागी)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Reclusive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine the other options:
 
 
• **Amiable: **This refers to a person who is friendly and pleasant.(मिलनसार)
 
• **Gregarious:** This refers to a person who enjoys being in crowds and socializing(सामूहिक)
 
• **Amicable:** This refers to having a disposition characterized by warmth and friendliness.(मिलनसार)
